def fmt(t):
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    m = t % 60
    ampm = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"

]

    ("Karen", LOC_INDEX["Pacific Heights"], 1125, 1215, 90),
    ("Mark", LOC_INDEX["Embarcadero"], 780, 1065, 120),
]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(0 <= m, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

    opt.add(0 <= fr[p], fr[p] <= N)
    opt.add(0 <= st[p], st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(0 <= en[p], en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, loc, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

def start_travel(fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        expr = If(fidx == i, IntVal(TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]), expr)
    return expr

def between_travel(prev_fidx, curr_fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        inner = IntVal(0)
        for j in reversed(range(N)):
            inner = If(curr_fidx == j, IntVal(TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]), inner)
        expr = If(prev_fidx == i, inner, expr)
    return expr

opt.add(Implies(m > 0, st[0] >= START_TIME + start_travel(fr[0])))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, st[p] >= en[p - 1] + between_travel(fr[p - 1], fr[p])))

def duration_expr(fidx):

    for i in reversed(range(N)):

    return expr

opt.maximize(m)
opt.maximize(total_minutes)

assert res == sat

    statements.append(f"You meet {name} for {meet_end - meet_start} minutes from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
    current_time = meet_end
    current_loc = loc
    current_loc_idx = loc_idx

print(statements)

from z3 import *

def fmt(t):

START_TIME = 540
LOCATIONS = ["North Beach", "Pacific Heights", "Embarcadero"]
LOC_INDEX = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(LOCATIONS)}

    [5, 11, 0],
]
START_INDEX = LOC_INDEX[START_LOC]
FRIENDS = [
    ("Karen", LOC_INDEX["Pacific Heights"], 1125, 1215, 90),
    ("Mark", LOC_INDEX["Embarcadero"], 780, 1065, 120),
]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(0 <= m, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(0 <= fr[p], fr[p] <= N)
    opt.add(0 <= st[p], st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(0 <= en[p], en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, loc, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

def start_travel(fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        expr = If(fidx == i, IntVal(TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]), expr)
    return expr

def between_travel(prev_fidx, curr_fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        inner = IntVal(0)
        for j in reversed(range(N)):
            inner = If(curr_fidx == j, IntVal(TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]), inner)
        expr = If(prev_fidx == i, inner, expr)
    return expr

opt.add(Implies(m > 0, st[0] >= START_TIME + start_travel(fr[0])))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, st[p] >= en[p - 1] + between_travel(fr[p - 1], fr[p])))

total_minutes = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    dur_expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        dur_expr = If(fr[p] == i, IntVal(FRIENDS[i][4]), dur_expr)
    total_minutes = total_minutes + dur_expr

total_start = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    total_start = total_start + st[p]

opt.maximize(m)
opt.maximize(total_minutes)
opt.minimize(total_start)

res = opt.check()
assert res == sat
model = opt.model()
m_val = model.eval(m, model_completion=True).as_long()

statements = [f"You start at {START_LOC} at {fmt(START_TIME)}."]
current_time = START_TIME
current_loc = START_LOC
current_loc_idx = START_INDEX

for p in range(m_val):

    name, loc_idx, _, _, _ = FRIENDS[i]
    loc = LOCATIONS[loc_idx]
    meet_start = model.eval(st[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    meet_end = model.eval(en[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    if current_loc != loc:

        statements.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
        current_time = arrive
        current_loc = loc
        current_loc_idx = loc_idx
    if current_time < meet_start:
        statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(meet_start)}.")
        current_time = meet_start
    statements.append(f"You meet {name} for {meet_end - meet_start} minutes from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
    current_time = meet_end
    current_loc = loc
    current_loc_idx = loc_idx

print(statements)

# Problem 1
from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    hour = (t // 60) % 24
    minute = t % 60
    ampm = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = hour % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{minute:02d}{ampm}"

START_LOC = "North Beach"
START_TIME = 540
LOCATIONS = ["North Beach", "Pacific Heights", "Embarcadero"]
LOC_INDEX = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(LOCATIONS)}
TRAVEL = [
    [0, 8, 6],
    [9, 0, 10],
    [5, 11, 0],
]
START_INDEX = LOC_INDEX[START_LOC]
FRIENDS = [
    ("Karen", LOC_INDEX["Pacific Heights"], 1125, 1215, 90),
    ("Mark", LOC_INDEX["Embarcadero"], 780, 1065, 120),
]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(m >= 0, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(fr[p] >= 0, fr[p] <= N)
    opt.add(st[p] >= 0, st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= 0, en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, _, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

for i in range(N):
    opt.add(Implies(And(m > 0, fr[0] == i), st[0] >= START_TIME + TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]))
for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, fr[p - 1] == i, fr[p] == j), st[p] >= en[p - 1] + TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]))

selected = [Bool(f"sel_{i}") for i in range(N)]
for i in range(N):
    opt.add(selected[i] == Or([fr[p] == i for p in range(N)]))

total_minutes = IntVal(0)
for i in range(N):
    total_minutes = total_minutes + If(selected[i], IntVal(FRIENDS[i][4]), IntVal(0))

total_start = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    total_start = total_start + st[p]

opt.maximize(m)
opt.maximize(total_minutes)
opt.minimize(total_start)

res = opt.check()
assert res == sat
model = opt.model()
m_val = model.eval(m, model_completion=True).as_long()

statements = [f"You start at {START_LOC} at {fmt(START_TIME)}."]
current_time = START_TIME
current_loc = START_LOC
current_loc_idx = START_INDEX

for p in range(m_val):
    i = model.eval(fr[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    name, loc_idx, _, _, _ = FRIENDS[i]
    loc = LOCATIONS[loc_idx]
    meet_start = model.eval(st[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    meet_end = model.eval(en[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    if current_loc != loc:
        t = TRAVEL[current_loc_idx][loc_idx]
        arrive = current_time + t
        statements.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
        current_time = arrive
        current_loc = loc
        current_loc_idx = loc_idx
    if current_time < meet_start:
        statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(meet_start)}.")
        current_time = meet_start
    statements.append(f"You meet {name} for {meet_end - meet_start} minutes from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
    current_time = meet_end
    current_loc = loc
    current_loc_idx = loc_idx

print(statements)

# Problem 1
from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    hour = (t // 60) % 24
    minute = t % 60
    ampm = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = hour % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{minute:02d}{ampm}"

START_LOC = "North Beach"
START_TIME = 540
LOCATIONS = ["North Beach", "Pacific Heights", "Embarcadero"]
LOC_INDEX = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(LOCATIONS)}
TRAVEL = [
    [0, 8, 6],
    [9, 0, 10],
    [5, 11, 0],
]
START_INDEX = LOC_INDEX[START_LOC]
FRIENDS = [
    ("Karen", LOC_INDEX["Pacific Heights"], 1125, 1215, 90),
    ("Mark", LOC_INDEX["Embarcadero"], 780, 1065, 120),
]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(m >= 0, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(fr[p] >= 0, fr[p] <= N)
    opt.add(st[p] >= 0, st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= 0, en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, _, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

for i in range(N):
    opt.add(Implies(And(m > 0, fr[0] == i), st[0] >= START_TIME + TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]))
for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, fr[p - 1] == i, fr[p] == j), st[p] >= en[p - 1] + TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]))

selected = [Bool(f"sel_{i}") for i in range(N)]
for i in range(N):
    opt.add(selected[i] == Or([fr[p] == i for p in range(N)]))

total_minutes = IntVal(0)
for i in range(N):
    total_minutes = total_minutes + If(selected[i], IntVal(FRIENDS[i][4]), IntVal(0))

total_start = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    total_start = total_start + st[p]

opt.maximize(m)
opt.maximize(total_minutes)
opt.minimize(total_start)

res = opt.check()
assert res == sat
model = opt.model()
m_val = model.eval(m, model_completion=True).as_long()

statements = [f"You start at {START_LOC} at {fmt(START_TIME)}."]
current_time = START_TIME
current_loc = START_LOC
current_loc_idx = START_INDEX

for p in range(m_val):
    i = model.eval(fr[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    name, loc_idx, _, _, _ = FRIENDS[i]
    loc = LOCATIONS[loc_idx]
    meet_start = model.eval(st[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    meet_end = model.eval(en[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    if current_loc != loc:
        t = TRAVEL[current_loc_idx][loc_idx]
        arrive = current_time + t
        statements.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
        current_time = arrive
        current_loc = loc
        current_loc_idx = loc_idx
    if current_time < meet_start:
        statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(meet_start)}.")
        current_time = meet_start
    statements.append(f"You meet {name} for {meet_end - meet_start} minutes from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
    current_time = meet_end
    current_loc = loc
    current_loc_idx = loc_idx

print(statements)

from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    m = t % 60
    ampm = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12

START_LOC = "North Beach"

LOC_INDEX = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(LOCATIONS)}

    [9, 0, 10],
    [5, 11, 0],
]
START_INDEX = LOC_INDEX[START_LOC]
FRIENDS = [
    ("Karen", LOC_INDEX["Pacific Heights"], 1125, 1215, 90),
    ("Mark", LOC_INDEX["Embarcadero"], 780, 1065, 120),
]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(0 <= m, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(0 <= fr[p], fr[p] <= N)
    opt.add(0 <= st[p], st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(0 <= en[p], en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, loc, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

def start_travel(fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        expr = If(fidx == i, IntVal(TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]), expr)
    return expr

def between_travel(prev_fidx, curr_fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        inner = IntVal(0)
        for j in reversed(range(N)):
            inner = If(curr_fidx == j, IntVal(TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]), inner)
        expr = If(prev_fidx == i, inner, expr)
    return expr

opt.add(Implies(m > 0, st[0] >= START_TIME + start_travel(fr[0])))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, st[p] >= en[p - 1] + between_travel(fr[p - 1], fr[p])))

def duration_expr(fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        expr = If(fidx == i, IntVal(FRIENDS[i][4]), expr)
    return expr

total_minutes = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    total_minutes = total_minutes + duration_expr(fr[p])

opt.maximize(m)
opt.maximize(total_minutes)

res = opt.check()
assert res == sat
model = opt.model()
m_val = model.eval(m, model_completion=True).as_long()

statements = [f"You start at {START_LOC} at {fmt(START_TIME)}."]
current_time = START_TIME
current_loc = START_LOC
current_loc_idx = START_INDEX

    if current_time < meet_start:

    current_time = meet_end
    current_loc = loc
    current_loc_idx = loc_idx

print(statements)

# Problem 1
from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    m = t % 60
    ampm = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{ampm}"

START_LOC = "North Beach"
START_TIME = 540
LOCATIONS = ["North Beach", "Pacific Heights", "Embarcadero"]
LOC_INDEX = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(LOCATIONS)}
TRAVEL = [
    [0, 8, 6],
    [9, 0, 10],
    [5, 11, 0],
]
START_INDEX = LOC_INDEX[START_LOC]
FRIENDS = [
    ("Karen", LOC_INDEX["Pacific Heights"], 1125, 1215, 90),
    ("Mark", LOC_INDEX["Embarcadero"], 780, 1065, 120),
]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(0 <= m, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(0 <= fr[p], fr[p] <= N)
    opt.add(0 <= st[p], st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(0 <= en[p], en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, loc, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

def start_travel(fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        expr = If(fidx == i, IntVal(TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]), expr)
    return expr

def between_travel(prev_fidx, curr_fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        inner = IntVal(0)
        for j in reversed(range(N)):
            inner = If(curr_fidx == j, IntVal(TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]), inner)
        expr = If(prev_fidx == i, inner, expr)
    return expr

opt.add(Implies(m > 0, st[0] >= START_TIME + start_travel(fr[0])))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, st[p] >= en[p - 1] + between_travel(fr[p - 1], fr[p])))

total_minutes = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    dur_expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        dur_expr = If(fr[p] == i, IntVal(FRIENDS[i][4]), dur_expr)
    total_minutes = total_minutes + dur_expr

total_start = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    total_start = total_start + st[p]

opt.maximize(m)
opt.maximize(total_minutes)
opt.minimize(total_start)

res = opt.check()
assert res == sat
model = opt.model()
m_val = model.eval(m, model_completion=True).as_long()

statements = [f"You start at {START_LOC} at {fmt(START_TIME)}."]
current_time = START_TIME
current_loc = START_LOC
current_loc_idx = START_INDEX

for p in range(m_val):
    i = model.eval(fr[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    name, loc_idx, _, _, _ = FRIENDS[i]
    loc = LOCATIONS[loc_idx]
    meet_start = model.eval(st[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    meet_end = model.eval(en[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    if current_loc != loc:
        t = TRAVEL[current_loc_idx][loc_idx]
        arrive = current_time + t
        statements.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
        current_time = arrive
        current_loc = loc
        current_loc_idx = loc_idx
    if current_time < meet_start:
        statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(meet_start)}.")
        current_time = meet_start
    statements.append(f"You meet {name} for {meet_end - meet_start} minutes from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
    current_time = meet_end
    current_loc = loc
    current_loc_idx = loc_idx

print(statements)

from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    m = t % 60
    ampm = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12

START_LOC = "North Beach"
START_TIME = 540
LOCATIONS = ["North Beach", "Pacific Heights", "Embarcadero"]
LOC_INDEX = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(LOCATIONS)}
TRAVEL = [
    [0, 8, 6],
    [9, 0, 10],
    [5, 11, 0],
]
START_INDEX = LOC_INDEX[START_LOC]
FRIENDS = [
    ("Karen", LOC_INDEX["Pacific Heights"], 1125, 1215, 90),
    ("Mark", LOC_INDEX["Embarcadero"], 780, 1065, 120),
]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(0 <= m, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(0 <= fr[p], fr[p] <= N)
    opt.add(0 <= st[p], st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(0 <= en[p], en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, loc, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

def start_travel(fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        expr = If(fidx == i, IntVal(TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]), expr)
    return expr

def between_travel(prev_fidx, curr_fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        inner = IntVal(0)
        for j in reversed(range(N)):
            inner = If(curr_fidx == j, IntVal(TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]), inner)
        expr = If(prev_fidx == i, inner, expr)
    return expr

opt.add(Implies(m > 0, st[0] >= START_TIME + start_travel(fr[0])))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, st[p] >= en[p - 1] + between_travel(fr[p - 1], fr[p])))

total_minutes = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    dur_expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        dur_expr = If(fr[p] == i, IntVal(FRIENDS[i][4]), dur_expr)
    total_minutes = total_minutes + dur_expr

total_start = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    total_start = total_start + st[p]

opt.maximize(m)
opt.maximize(total_minutes)
opt.minimize(total_start)

res = opt.check()
assert res == sat
model = opt.model()
m_val = model.eval(m, model_completion=True).as_long()

statements = [f"You start at {START_LOC} at {fmt(START_TIME)}."]
current_time = START_TIME
current_loc = START_LOC
current_loc_idx = START_INDEX

for p in range(m_val):
    i = model.eval(fr[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    name, loc_idx, _, _, _ = FRIENDS[i]
    loc = LOCATIONS[loc_idx]
    meet_start = model.eval(st[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    meet_end = model.eval(en[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    if current_loc != loc:
        t = TRAVEL[current_loc_idx][loc_idx]
        arrive = current_time + t
        statements.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
        current_time = arrive
        current_loc = loc
        current_loc_idx = loc_idx
    if current_time < meet_start:
        statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(meet_start)}.")
        current_time = meet_start
    statements.append(f"You meet {name} for {meet_end - meet_start} minutes from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
    current_time = meet_end
    current_loc = loc
    current_loc_idx = loc_idx

print(statements)

from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    m = t % 60
    ampm = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{ampm}"

START_LOC = "North Beach"
START_TIME = 540
LOCATIONS = ["North Beach", "Pacific Heights", "Embarcadero"]
LOC_INDEX = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(LOCATIONS)}
TRAVEL = [
    [0, 8, 6],
    [9, 0, 10],
    [5, 11, 0],
]
START_INDEX = LOC_INDEX[START_LOC]
FRIENDS = [
    ("Karen", LOC_INDEX["Pacific Heights"], 1125, 1215, 90),
    ("Mark", LOC_INDEX["Embarcadero"], 780, 1065, 120),
]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(0 <= m, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(0 <= fr[p], fr[p] <= N)
    opt.add(0 <= st[p], st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(0 <= en[p], en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, loc, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

def start_travel(fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        expr = If(fidx == i, IntVal(TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]), expr)
    return expr

def between_travel(prev_fidx, curr_fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        inner = IntVal(0)
        for j in reversed(range(N)):
            inner = If(curr_fidx == j, IntVal(TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]), inner)
        expr = If(prev_fidx == i, inner, expr)
    return expr

opt.add(Implies(m > 0, st[0] >= START_TIME + start_travel(fr[0])))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, st[p] >= en[p - 1] + between_travel(fr[p - 1], fr[p])))

def duration_expr(fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        expr = If(fidx == i, IntVal(FRIENDS[i][4]), expr)
    return expr

total_minutes = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    total_minutes = total_minutes + duration_expr(fr[p])

opt.maximize(m)
opt.maximize(total_minutes)

res = opt.check()
assert res == sat
model = opt.model()
m_val = model.eval(m, model_completion=True).as_long()

statements = [f"You start at {START_LOC} at {fmt(START_TIME)}."]
current_time = START_TIME
current_loc = START_LOC
current_loc_idx = START_INDEX

for p in range(m_val):
    i = model.eval(fr[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    name, loc_idx, avail_s, avail_e, dur = FRIENDS[i]
    loc = LOCATIONS[loc_idx]
    meet_start = model.eval(st[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    meet_end = model.eval(en[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    if current_loc != loc:
        t = TRAVEL[current_loc_idx][loc_idx]
        arrive = current_time + t
        statements.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
        current_time = arrive
        current_loc = loc
        current_loc_idx = loc_idx
    if current_time < meet_start:
        statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(meet_start)}.")
        current_time = meet_start
    statements.append(f"You meet {name} for {meet_end - meet_start} minutes from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
    current_time = meet_end
    current_loc = loc
    current_loc_idx = loc_idx

print(statements)

# Problem 1
from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    m = t % 60
    ampm = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{ampm}"

START_LOC = "North Beach"
START_TIME = 540
LOCATIONS = ["North Beach", "Pacific Heights", "Embarcadero"]
LOC_INDEX = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(LOCATIONS)}
TRAVEL = [
    [0, 8, 6],
    [9, 0, 10],
    [5, 11, 0],
]
START_INDEX = LOC_INDEX[START_LOC]
FRIENDS = [
    ("Karen", LOC_INDEX["Pacific Heights"], 1125, 1215, 90),
    ("Mark", LOC_INDEX["Embarcadero"], 780, 1065, 120),
]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(0 <= m, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(0 <= fr[p], fr[p] <= N)
    opt.add(0 <= st[p], st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(0 <= en[p], en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, loc, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

def start_travel(fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        expr = If(fidx == i, IntVal(TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]), expr)
    return expr

def between_travel(prev_fidx, curr_fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        inner = IntVal(0)
        for j in reversed(range(N)):
            inner = If(curr_fidx == j, IntVal(TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]), inner)
        expr = If(prev_fidx == i, inner, expr)
    return expr

opt.add(Implies(m > 0, st[0] >= START_TIME + start_travel(fr[0])))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, st[p] >= en[p - 1] + between_travel(fr[p - 1], fr[p])))

total_minutes = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    dur_expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        dur_expr = If(fr[p] == i, IntVal(FRIENDS[i][4]), dur_expr)
    total_minutes = total_minutes + dur_expr

total_start = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    total_start = total_start + st[p]

opt.maximize(m)
opt.maximize(total_minutes)
opt.minimize(total_start)

res = opt.check()
assert res == sat
model = opt.model()
m_val = model.eval(m, model_completion=True).as_long()

statements = [f"You start at {START_LOC} at {fmt(START_TIME)}."]
current_time = START_TIME
current_loc = START_LOC
current_loc_idx = START_INDEX

for p in range(m_val):
    i = model.eval(fr[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    name, loc_idx, _, _, _ = FRIENDS[i]
    loc = LOCATIONS[loc_idx]
    meet_start = model.eval(st[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    meet_end = model.eval(en[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    if current_loc != loc:
        t = TRAVEL[current_loc_idx][loc_idx]
        arrive = current_time + t
        statements.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
        current_time = arrive
        current_loc = loc
        current_loc_idx = loc_idx
    if current_time < meet_start:
        statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(meet_start)}.")
        current_time = meet_start
    statements.append(f"You meet {name} for {meet_end - meet_start} minutes from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
    current_time = meet_end
    current_loc = loc
    current_loc_idx = loc_idx

print(statements)

def fmt(t):

    minute = t % 60
    ampm = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = hour % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{minute:02d}{ampm}"

START_LOC = "North Beach"
START_TIME = 540
LOCATIONS = ["North Beach", "Pacific Heights", "Embarcadero"]
LOC_INDEX = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(LOCATIONS)}

    [0, 8, 6],

    [5, 11, 0],
]

    ("Karen", LOC_INDEX["Pacific Heights"], 1125, 1215, 90),
    ("Mark", LOC_INDEX["Embarcadero"], 780, 1065, 120),
]

m = Int("m")

st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

for p in range(N):

    opt.add(st[p] >= 0, st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= 0, en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, _, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

for i in range(N):
    opt.add(Implies(And(m > 0, fr[0] == i), st[0] >= START_TIME + TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]))
for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, fr[p - 1] == i, fr[p] == j), st[p] >= en[p - 1] + TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]))

# Problem 4
from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    hour = (t // 60) % 24
    minute = t % 60
    ampm = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = hour % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{minute:02d}{ampm}"

START_LOC = "Nob Hill"
START_TIME = 540
LOCATIONS = ["Nob Hill", "Presidio"]
LOC_INDEX = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(LOCATIONS)}
TRAVEL = [
    [0, 17],
    [18, 0],
]
START_INDEX = LOC_INDEX[START_LOC]
FRIENDS = [
    ("Robert", LOC_INDEX["Presidio"], 675, 1065, 120),
]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(m >= 0, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(fr[p] >= 0, fr[p] <= N)
    opt.add(st[p] >= 0, st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= 0, en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, _, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

for i in range(N):
    opt.add(Implies(And(m > 0, fr[0] == i), st[0] >= START_TIME + TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]))
for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, fr[p - 1] == i, fr[p] == j), st[p] >= en[p - 1] + TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]))

selected = [Bool(f"sel_{i}") for i in range(N)]
for i in range(N):
    opt.add(selected[i] == Or([fr[p] == i for p in range(N)]))

total_minutes = IntVal(0)
for i in range(N):
    total_minutes = total_minutes + If(selected[i], IntVal(FRIENDS[i][4]), IntVal(0))

total_start = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    total_start = total_start + st[p]

opt.maximize(m)
opt.maximize(total_minutes)
opt.minimize(total_start)

res = opt.check()
assert res == sat
model = opt.model()
m_val = model.eval(m, model_completion=True).as_long()

statements = [f"You start at {START_LOC} at {fmt(START_TIME)}."]
current_time = START_TIME
current_loc = START_LOC
current_loc_idx = START_INDEX

for p in range(m_val):
    i = model.eval(fr[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    name, loc_idx, _, _, _ = FRIENDS[i]
    loc = LOCATIONS[loc_idx]
    meet_start = model.eval(st[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    meet_end = model.eval(en[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
    if current_loc != loc:
        t = TRAVEL[current_loc_idx][loc_idx]
        arrive = current_time + t
        statements.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
        current_time = arrive
        current_loc = loc
        current_loc_idx = loc_idx
    if current_time < meet_start:
        statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(meet_start)}.")
        current_time = meet_start
    statements.append(f"You meet {name} for {meet_end - meet_start} minutes from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
    current_time = meet_end
    current_loc = loc
    current_loc_idx = loc_idx

print(statements)

from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    h = (t // 60) % 24
    m = t % 60
    ampm = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{ampm}"

START_LOC = "North Beach"
START_TIME = 540
LOCATIONS = ["North Beach", "Pacific Heights", "Embarcadero"]
LOC_INDEX = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(LOCATIONS)}
TRAVEL = [
    [0, 8, 6],
    [9, 0, 10],
    [5, 11, 0],
]
START_INDEX = LOC_INDEX[START_LOC]
FRIENDS = [
    ("Karen", LOC_INDEX["Pacific Heights"], 1125, 1215, 90),
    ("Mark", LOC_INDEX["Embarcadero"], 780, 1065, 120),
]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(0 <= m, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(0 <= fr[p], fr[p] <= N)
    opt.add(0 <= st[p], st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(0 <= en[p], en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, loc, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

def start_travel(fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        expr = If(fidx == i, IntVal(TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]), expr)
    return expr

def between_travel(prev_fidx, curr_fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        inner = IntVal(0)
        for j in reversed(range(N)):
            inner = If(curr_fidx == j, IntVal(TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]), inner)
        expr = If(prev_fidx == i, inner, expr)
    return expr

opt.add(Implies(m > 0, st[0] >= START_TIME + start_travel(fr[0])))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, st[p] >= en[p - 1] + between_travel(fr[p - 1], fr[p])))

def duration_expr(fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        expr = If(fidx == i, IntVal(FRIENDS[i][4]), expr)
    return expr

opt.maximize(m)
opt.maximize(total_minutes)

assert res == sat

    current_time = meet_end

print(statements)

]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(0 <= m, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

    opt.add(0 <= st[p], st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(0 <= en[p], en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

def start_travel(fidx):

    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        expr = If(fidx == i, IntVal(TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]), expr)
    return expr

def between_travel(prev_fidx, curr_fidx):
    expr = IntVal(0)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        inner = IntVal(0)
        for j in reversed(range(N)):
            inner = If(curr_fidx == j, IntVal(TRAVEL[FRIENDS[i][1]][FRIENDS[j][1]]), inner)
        expr = If(prev_fidx == i, inner, expr)
    return expr

opt.add(Implies(m > 0, st[0] >= START_TIME + start_travel(fr[0])))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, st[p] >= en[p - 1] + between_travel(fr[p - 1], fr[p])))

from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    hour = (t // 60) % 24
    minute = t % 60
    ampm = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = hour % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{minute:02d}{ampm}"

START_LOC = "North Beach"
START_TIME = 540
LOCATIONS = ["North Beach", "Pacific Heights", "Embarcadero"]
LOC_INDEX = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(LOCATIONS)}

    [9, 0, 10],
    [5, 11, 0],
]
START_INDEX = LOC_INDEX[START_LOC]
FRIENDS = [
    ("Karen", LOC_INDEX["Pacific Heights"], 1125, 1215, 90),
    ("Mark", LOC_INDEX["Embarcadero"], 780, 1065, 120),
]
N = len(FRIENDS)

opt = Optimize()
m = Int("m")
opt.add(m >= 0, m <= N)
fr = [Int(f"fr_{i}") for i in range(N)]
st = [Int(f"st_{i}") for i in range(N)]
en = [Int(f"en_{i}") for i in range(N)]

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(fr[p] >= 0, fr[p] <= N)
    opt.add(st[p] >= 0, st[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= 0, en[p] <= 1500)
    opt.add(en[p] >= st[p])
    opt.add(Implies(p >= m, fr[p] == N))
    opt.add(Implies(p < m, fr[p] <= N - 1))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < m, q < m), fr[p] != fr[q]))

for p in range(N):
    for i, (_, _, avail_s, avail_e, dur) in enumerate(FRIENDS):
        opt.add(Implies(fr[p] == i, And(st[p] >= avail_s, st[p] + dur <= avail_e, en[p] == st[p] + dur)))

for i in range(N):
    opt.add(Implies(And(m > 0, fr[0] == i), st[0] >= START_TIME + TRAVEL[START_INDEX][FRIENDS[i][1]]))
for p in range(1, N):

total_minutes = IntVal(0)
for i in range(N):
    total_minutes = total_minutes + If(selected[i], IntVal(FRIENDS[i][4]), IntVal(0))

total_start = IntVal(0)
for p in range(N):
    total_start = total_start + st[p]

opt.maximize(m)
opt.maximize(total_minutes)
opt.minimize(total_start)

assert res == sat

statements = [f"You start at {START_LOC} at {fmt(START_TIME)}."]

current_loc = START_LOC
current_loc_idx = START_INDEX

    statements.append(f"You meet {name} for {meet_end - meet_start} minutes from {fmt(meet_start)} to {fmt(meet_end)}.")
    current_time = meet_end
    current_loc = loc
    current_loc_idx = loc_idx

print(statements)

# Problem 1
from z3 import *

def fmt(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    mm = m % 60
    if h == 0:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = 12
    elif h < 12:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = h
    elif h == 12:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = 12
    else:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = h - 12
    return f"{hh}:{mm:02d}{ap}"

def quote(s):
    if "'" in s:
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return "'" + s + "'"

locs = ["The Castro", "Mission District", "Financial District"]
travel = [
    [0, 7, 20],
    [7, 0, 17],
    [23, 17, 0]
]
start_loc = 0
start_min = 540
friends = [
    ("Laura", 1, 735, 1185, 75),
    ("Anthony", 2, 750, 885, 30)
]

N = len(friends)
opt = Optimize()
k = Int("k")
opt.add(k >= 0, k <= N)
f = [Int(f"f_{p}") for p in range(N)]
start = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(N)]
end = [Int(f"end_{p}") for p in range(N)]
tcost = [Int(f"tcost_{p}") for p in range(N)]
max_t = max(max(row) for row in travel)

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(f[p] >= 0, f[p] <= N)
    opt.add(start[p] >= 0, start[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(end[p] >= 0, end[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(tcost[p] >= 0, tcost[p] <= max_t)
    active = (p < k)
    opt.add(Implies(active, f[p] < N))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(active), And(f[p] == N, start[p] == 0, end[p] == 0, tcost[p] == 0)))
    for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
        opt.add(Implies(f[p] == i, And(start[p] >= a, start[p] + d <= b, end[p] == start[p] + d)))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < k, q < k), f[p] != f[q]))

for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(Implies(f[0] == i, tcost[0] == travel[start_loc][loc]))
for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(f[p - 1] == i, f[p] == j), tcost[p] == travel[friends[i][1]][friends[j][1]]))

opt.add(Implies(k > 0, start[0] >= tcost[0] + start_min))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < k, start[p] >= end[p - 1] + tcost[p]))

total_end = end[0]
for p in range(1, N):
    total_end = total_end + end[p]
opt.maximize(k)
opt.minimize(total_end)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    k_val = m.eval(k, model_completion=True).as_long()
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    cur = start_min
    cur_loc = start_loc
    for p in range(k_val):
        i = m.eval(f[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        name, loc, a, b, d = friends[i]
        t = travel[cur_loc][loc]
        if t > 0:
            arrive = cur + t
            ans.append(f"You travel to {locs[loc]} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
            cur = arrive
            cur_loc = loc
        else:
            cur_loc = loc
        ms = m.eval(start[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        me = m.eval(end[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        if ms > cur:
            ans.append(f"You wait until {fmt(ms)}.")
            cur = ms
        ans.append(f"You meet {name} for {me - ms} minutes from {fmt(ms)} to {fmt(me)}.")
        cur = me
    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')
else:
    print('[]')
```

# Problem 1
from z3 import *

def fmt(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    mm = m % 60
    if h == 0:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = 12
    elif h < 12:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = h
    elif h == 12:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = 12
    else:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = h - 12
    return f"{hh}:{mm:02d}{ap}"

def quote(s):
    if "'" in s:
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return "'" + s + "'"

locs = ["The Castro", "Mission District", "Financial District"]
travel = [
    [0, 7, 20],
    [7, 0, 17],
    [23, 17, 0]
]
start_loc = 0
start_min = 540
friends = [
    ("Laura", 1, 735, 1185, 75),
    ("Anthony", 2, 750, 885, 30)
]

N = len(friends)
opt = Optimize()
k = Int("k")
opt.add(k >= 0, k <= N)

f = [Int(f"f_{p}") for p in range(N)]
start = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(N)]
end = [Int(f"end_{p}") for p in range(N)]
tcost = [Int(f"tcost_{p}") for p in range(N)]
max_t = max(max(row) for row in travel)

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(f[p] >= 0, f[p] <= N)
    opt.add(start[p] >= 0, start[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(end[p] >= 0, end[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(tcost[p] >= 0, tcost[p] <= max_t)

    active = (p < k)
    opt.add(Implies(active, f[p] < N))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(active), And(f[p] == N, start[p] == 0, end[p] == 0, tcost[p] == 0)))

    for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
        opt.add(Implies(f[p] == i, And(start[p] >= a, start[p] + d <= b, end[p] == start[p] + d)))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < k, q < k), f[p] != f[q]))

for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(Implies(f[0] == i, tcost[0] == travel[start_loc][loc]))

for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(f[p - 1] == i, f[p] == j), tcost[p] == travel[friends[i][1]][friends[j][1]]))

opt.add(Implies(k > 0, start[0] >= tcost[0] + start_min))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < k, start[p] >= end[p - 1] + tcost[p]))

total_end = end[0]
for p in range(1, N):
    total_end = total_end + end[p]

opt.maximize(k)
opt.minimize(total_end)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    k_val = m.eval(k, model_completion=True).as_long()
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    cur = start_min
    cur_loc = start_loc

    for p in range(k_val):
        i = m.eval(f[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        name, loc, a, b, d = friends[i]

        t = travel[cur_loc][loc]
        if t > 0:
            arrive = cur + t
            ans.append(f"You travel to {locs[loc]} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
            cur = arrive
            cur_loc = loc
        else:
            cur_loc = loc

        ms = m.eval(start[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        me = m.eval(end[p], model_completion=True).as_long()

        if ms > cur:
            ans.append(f"You wait until {fmt(ms)}.")
            cur = ms

        ans.append(f"You meet {name} for {me - ms} minutes from {fmt(ms)} to {fmt(me)}.")
        cur = me

    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')
else:
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')

# Problem 1
from z3 import *

def fmt(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    mm = m % 60
    if h == 0:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = 12
    elif h < 12:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = h
    elif h == 12:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = 12
    else:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = h - 12
    return f"{hh}:{mm:02d}{ap}"

def quote(s):
    if "'" in s:
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return "'" + s + "'"

locs = ["The Castro", "Mission District", "Financial District"]
travel = [
    [0, 7, 20],
    [7, 0, 17],
    [23, 17, 0]
]
start_loc = 0
start_min = 540
friends = [
    ("Laura", 1, 735, 1185, 75),
    ("Anthony", 2, 750, 885, 30)
]

N = len(friends)
opt = Optimize()
k = Int("k")
opt.add(k >= 0, k <= N)
f = [Int(f"f_{p}") for p in range(N)]
start = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(N)]
end = [Int(f"end_{p}") for p in range(N)]
tcost = [Int(f"tcost_{p}") for p in range(N)]
max_t = max(max(row) for row in travel)

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(f[p] >= 0, f[p] <= N)
    opt.add(start[p] >= 0, start[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(end[p] >= 0, end[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(tcost[p] >= 0, tcost[p] <= max_t)
    active = (p < k)
    opt.add(Implies(active, f[p] < N))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(active), And(f[p] == N, start[p] == 0, end[p] == 0, tcost[p] == 0)))
    for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
        opt.add(Implies(f[p] == i, And(start[p] >= a, start[p] + d <= b, end[p] == start[p] + d)))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < k, q < k), f[p] != f[q]))

for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(Implies(f[0] == i, tcost[0] == travel[start_loc][loc]))
for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(f[p - 1] == i, f[p] == j), tcost[p] == travel[friends[i][1]][friends[j][1]]))

opt.add(Implies(k > 0, start[0] >= tcost[0] + start_min))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < k, start[p] >= end[p - 1] + tcost[p]))

total_end = end[0]
for p in range(1, N):
    total_end = total_end + end[p]
opt.maximize(k)
opt.minimize(total_end)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    k_val = m.eval(k, model_completion=True).as_long()
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    cur = start_min
    cur_loc = start_loc
    for p in range(k_val):
        i = m.eval(f[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        name, loc, a, b, d = friends[i]
        t = travel[cur_loc][loc]
        if t > 0:
            arrive = cur + t
            ans.append(f"You travel to {locs[loc]} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
            cur = arrive
            cur_loc = loc
        else:
            cur_loc = loc
        ms = m.eval(start[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        me = m.eval(end[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        if ms > cur:
            ans.append(f"You wait until {fmt(ms)}.")
            cur = ms
        ans.append(f"You meet {name} for {me - ms} minutes from {fmt(ms)} to {fmt(me)}.")
        cur = me
    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')
else:
    print('[]')

# Problem 2
from z3 import *

def fmt(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    mm = m % 60
    if h == 0:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = 12
    elif h < 12:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = h
    elif h == 12:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = 12
    else:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = h - 12
    return f"{hh}:{mm:02d}{ap}"

def quote(s):
    if "'" in s:
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return "'" + s + "'"

locs = [
    "Pacific Heights",
    "Marina District",
    "The Castro",
    "Richmond District",
    "Alamo Square",
    "Financial District",
    "Presidio",
    "Mission District",
    "Nob Hill",
    "Russian Hill"
]
travel = [
    [0, 6, 16, 12, 10, 13, 11, 15, 8, 7],
    [7, 0, 22, 11, 15, 17, 10, 20, 12, 8],
    [16, 21, 0, 16, 8, 21, 20, 7, 16, 18],
    [10, 9, 16, 0, 13, 22, 7, 20, 17, 13],
    [10, 15, 8, 11, 0, 17, 17, 10, 11, 13],
    [13, 15, 20, 21, 17, 0, 22, 17, 8, 11],
    [11, 11, 21, 7, 19, 23, 0, 26, 18, 14],
    [16, 19, 7, 20, 11, 15, 25, 0, 12, 15],
    [8, 11, 17, 14, 11, 9, 17, 13, 0, 5],
    [7, 7, 21, 14, 15, 11, 14, 16, 5, 0]
]
start_loc = 0
start_min = 540
friends = [
    ("Linda", 1, 1080, 1320, 30),
    ("Kenneth", 2, 885, 975, 30),
    ("Kimberly", 3, 855, 1320, 30),
    ("Paul", 4, 1260, 1290, 15),
    ("Carol", 5, 615, 720, 60),
    ("Brian", 6, 600, 1290, 75),
    ("Laura", 7, 975, 1170, 30),
    ("Sandra", 8, 555, 1110, 60),
    ("Karen", 9, 1110, 1320, 75)
]

N = len(friends)
opt = Optimize()
k = Int("k")
opt.add(k >= 0, k <= N)

f = [Int(f"f_{p}") for p in range(N)]
start = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(N)]
end = [Int(f"end_{p}") for p in range(N)]
tcost = [Int(f"tcost_{p}") for p in range(N)]
max_t = max(max(row) for row in travel)

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(f[p] >= 0, f[p] <= N)
    opt.add(start[p] >= 0, start[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(end[p] >= 0, end[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(tcost[p] >= 0, tcost[p] <= max_t)

    active = (p < k)
    opt.add(Implies(active, f[p] < N))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(active), And(f[p] == N, start[p] == 0, end[p] == 0, tcost[p] == 0)))

    for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
        opt.add(Implies(f[p] == i, And(start[p] >= a, start[p] + d <= b, end[p] == start[p] + d)))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < k, q < k), f[p] != f[q]))

for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(Implies(f[0] == i, tcost[0] == travel[start_loc][loc]))

for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(f[p - 1] == i, f[p] == j), tcost[p] == travel[friends[i][1]][friends[j][1]]))

opt.add(Implies(k > 0, start[0] >= tcost[0] + start_min))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < k, start[p] >= end[p - 1] + tcost[p]))

total_end = end[0]
for p in range(1, N):
    total_end = total_end + end[p]

opt.maximize(k)
opt.minimize(total_end)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    k_val = m.eval(k, model_completion=True).as_long()
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    cur = start_min
    cur_loc = start_loc

    for p in range(k_val):
        i = m.eval(f[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        name, loc, a, b, d = friends[i]

        t = travel[cur_loc][loc]
        if t > 0:
            arrive = cur + t
            ans.append(f"You travel to {locs[loc]} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
            cur = arrive
            cur_loc = loc
        else:
            cur_loc = loc

        ms = m.eval(start[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        me = m.eval(end[p], model_completion=True).as_long()

        if ms > cur:
            ans.append(f"You wait until {fmt(ms)}.")
            cur = ms

        ans.append(f"You meet {name} for {me - ms} minutes from {fmt(ms)} to {fmt(me)}.")
        cur = me

    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')
else:
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')

# Problem 1
from z3 import *

def fmt(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    mm = m % 60
    if h == 0:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = 12
    elif h < 12:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = h
    elif h == 12:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = 12
    else:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = h - 12
    return f"{hh}:{mm:02d}{ap}"

def quote(s):
    if "'" in s:
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return "'" + s + "'"

locs = ["The Castro", "Mission District", "Financial District"]
travel = [
    [0, 7, 20],
    [7, 0, 17],
    [23, 17, 0]
]
start_loc = 0
start_min = 540
friends = [
    ("Laura", 1, 735, 1185, 75),
    ("Anthony", 2, 750, 885, 30)
]

N = len(friends)
opt = Optimize()
k = Int("k")
opt.add(k >= 0, k <= N)
f = [Int(f"f_{p}") for p in range(N)]
start = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(N)]
end = [Int(f"end_{p}") for p in range(N)]
tcost = [Int(f"tcost_{p}") for p in range(N)]
max_t = max(max(row) for row in travel)

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(f[p] >= 0, f[p] <= N)
    opt.add(start[p] >= 0, start[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(end[p] >= 0, end[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(tcost[p] >= 0, tcost[p] <= max_t)
    active = (p < k)
    opt.add(Implies(active, f[p] < N))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(active), And(f[p] == N, start[p] == 0, end[p] == 0, tcost[p] == 0)))
    for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
        opt.add(Implies(f[p] == i, And(start[p] >= a, start[p] + d <= b, end[p] == start[p] + d)))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < k, q < k), f[p] != f[q]))

for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(Implies(f[0] == i, tcost[0] == travel[start_loc][loc]))
for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(f[p - 1] == i, f[p] == j), tcost[p] == travel[friends[i][1]][friends[j][1]]))

opt.add(Implies(k > 0, start[0] >= tcost[0] + start_min))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < k, start[p] >= end[p - 1] + tcost[p]))

total_end = end[0]
for p in range(1, N):
    total_end = total_end + end[p]
opt.maximize(k)
opt.minimize(total_end)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    k_val = m.eval(k, model_completion=True).as_long()
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    cur = start_min
    cur_loc = start_loc
    for p in range(k_val):
        i = m.eval(f[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        name, loc, a, b, d = friends[i]
        t = travel[cur_loc][loc]
        if t > 0:
            arrive = cur + t
            ans.append(f"You travel to {locs[loc]} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
            cur = arrive
            cur_loc = loc
        else:
            cur_loc = loc
        ms = m.eval(start[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        me = m.eval(end[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        if ms > cur:
            ans.append(f"You wait until {fmt(ms)}.")
            cur = ms
        ans.append(f"You meet {name} for {me - ms} minutes from {fmt(ms)} to {fmt(me)}.")
        cur = me
    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')
else:
    print('[]')

# Problem 3
from z3 import *

def fmt(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    mm = m % 60
    if h == 0:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = 12
    elif h < 12:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = h
    elif h == 12:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = 12
    else:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = h - 12
    return f"{hh}:{mm:02d}{ap}"

def quote(s):
    if "'" in s:
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return "'" + s + "'"

locs = [
    "Sunset District",
    "Alamo Square",
    "Russian Hill",
    "Golden Gate Park",
    "Mission District"
]
travel = [
    [0, 17, 24, 11, 24],
    [16, 0, 13, 9, 10],
    [23, 15, 0, 21, 16],
    [10, 10, 19, 0, 17],
    [24, 11, 15, 17, 0]
]
start_loc = 0
start_min = 540
friends = [
    ("Charles", 1, 1080, 1245, 90),
    ("Margaret", 2, 540, 960, 30),
    ("Daniel", 3, 480, 810, 15),
    ("Stephanie", 4, 1170, 1320, 90)
]

N = len(friends)
opt = Optimize()
k = Int("k")
opt.add(k >= 0, k <= N)

f = [Int(f"f_{p}") for p in range(N)]
start = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(N)]
end = [Int(f"end_{p}") for p in range(N)]
tcost = [Int(f"tcost_{p}") for p in range(N)]
max_t = max(max(row) for row in travel)

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(f[p] >= 0, f[p] <= N)
    opt.add(start[p] >= 0, start[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(end[p] >= 0, end[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(tcost[p] >= 0, tcost[p] <= max_t)

    active = (p < k)
    opt.add(Implies(active, f[p] < N))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(active), And(f[p] == N, start[p] == 0, end[p] == 0, tcost[p] == 0)))

    for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
        opt.add(Implies(f[p] == i, And(start[p] >= a, start[p] + d <= b, end[p] == start[p] + d)))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < k, q < k), f[p] != f[q]))

for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(Implies(f[0] == i, tcost[0] == travel[start_loc][loc]))

for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(f[p - 1] == i, f[p] == j), tcost[p] == travel[friends[i][1]][friends[j][1]]))

opt.add(Implies(k > 0, start[0] >= tcost[0] + start_min))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < k, start[p] >= end[p - 1] + tcost[p]))

total_end = end[0]
for p in range(1, N):
    total_end = total_end + end[p]

opt.maximize(k)
opt.minimize(total_end)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    k_val = m.eval(k, model_completion=True).as_long()
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    cur = start_min
    cur_loc = start_loc

    for p in range(k_val):
        i = m.eval(f[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        name, loc, a, b, d = friends[i]

        t = travel[cur_loc][loc]
        if t > 0:
            arrive = cur + t
            ans.append(f"You travel to {locs[loc]} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
            cur = arrive
            cur_loc = loc
        else:
            cur_loc = loc

        ms = m.eval(start[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        me = m.eval(end[p], model_completion=True).as_long()

        if ms > cur:
            ans.append(f"You wait until {fmt(ms)}.")
            cur = ms

        ans.append(f"You meet {name} for {me - ms} minutes from {fmt(ms)} to {fmt(me)}.")
        cur = me

    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')
else:
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')

# Problem 1
from z3 import *

def fmt(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    mm = m % 60
    if h == 0:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = 12
    elif h < 12:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = h
    elif h == 12:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = 12
    else:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = h - 12
    return f"{hh}:{mm:02d}{ap}"

def quote(s):
    if "'" in s:
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return "'" + s + "'"

locs = ["The Castro", "Mission District", "Financial District"]
travel = [
    [0, 7, 20],
    [7, 0, 17],
    [23, 17, 0]
]
start_loc = 0
start_min = 540
friends = [
    ("Laura", 1, 735, 1185, 75),
    ("Anthony", 2, 750, 885, 30)
]

N = len(friends)
opt = Optimize()
k = Int("k")
opt.add(k >= 0, k <= N)
f = [Int(f"f_{p}") for p in range(N)]
start = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(N)]
end = [Int(f"end_{p}") for p in range(N)]
tcost = [Int(f"tcost_{p}") for p in range(N)]
max_t = max(max(row) for row in travel)

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(f[p] >= 0, f[p] <= N)
    opt.add(start[p] >= 0, start[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(end[p] >= 0, end[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(tcost[p] >= 0, tcost[p] <= max_t)
    active = (p < k)
    opt.add(Implies(active, f[p] < N))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(active), And(f[p] == N, start[p] == 0, end[p] == 0, tcost[p] == 0)))
    for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
        opt.add(Implies(f[p] == i, And(start[p] >= a, start[p] + d <= b, end[p] == start[p] + d)))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < k, q < k), f[p] != f[q]))

for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(Implies(f[0] == i, tcost[0] == travel[start_loc][loc]))
for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(f[p - 1] == i, f[p] == j), tcost[p] == travel[friends[i][1]][friends[j][1]]))

opt.add(Implies(k > 0, start[0] >= tcost[0] + start_min))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < k, start[p] >= end[p - 1] + tcost[p]))

total_end = end[0]
for p in range(1, N):
    total_end = total_end + end[p]
opt.maximize(k)
opt.minimize(total_end)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    k_val = m.eval(k, model_completion=True).as_long()
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    cur = start_min
    cur_loc = start_loc
    for p in range(k_val):
        i = m.eval(f[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        name, loc, a, b, d = friends[i]
        t = travel[cur_loc][loc]
        if t > 0:
            arrive = cur + t
            ans.append(f"You travel to {locs[loc]} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
            cur = arrive
            cur_loc = loc
        else:
            cur_loc = loc
        ms = m.eval(start[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        me = m.eval(end[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        if ms > cur:
            ans.append(f"You wait until {fmt(ms)}.")
            cur = ms
        ans.append(f"You meet {name} for {me - ms} minutes from {fmt(ms)} to {fmt(me)}.")
        cur = me
    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')
else:
    print('[]')

# Problem 4
from z3 import *

def fmt(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    mm = m % 60
    if h == 0:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = 12
    elif h < 12:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = h
    elif h == 12:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = 12
    else:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = h - 12
    return f"{hh}:{mm:02d}{ap}"

def quote(s):
    if "'" in s:
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return "'" + s + "'"

locs = [
    "Embarcadero",
    "Richmond District",
    "Union Square",
    "Financial District",
    "Pacific Heights",
    "Nob Hill",
    "Bayview"
]
travel = [
    [0, 21, 10, 5, 11, 10, 21],
    [19, 0, 21, 22, 10, 17, 26],
    [11, 20, 0, 9, 15, 9, 15],
    [4, 21, 9, 0, 13, 8, 19],
    [10, 12, 12, 13, 0, 8, 22],
    [9, 14, 7, 9, 8, 0, 19],
    [19, 25, 17, 19, 23, 20, 0]
]
start_loc = 0
start_min = 540
friends = [
    ("Kenneth", 1, 1275, 1320, 30),
    ("Lisa", 2, 540, 990, 45),
    ("Joshua", 3, 720, 975, 15),
    ("Nancy", 4, 480, 690, 90),
    ("Andrew", 5, 690, 1215, 60),
    ("John", 6, 1005, 1290, 75)
]

N = len(friends)
opt = Optimize()
k = Int("k")
opt.add(k >= 0, k <= N)

f = [Int(f"f_{p}") for p in range(N)]
start = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(N)]
end = [Int(f"end_{p}") for p in range(N)]
tcost = [Int(f"tcost_{p}") for p in range(N)]
max_t = max(max(row) for row in travel)

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(f[p] >= 0, f[p] <= N)
    opt.add(start[p] >= 0, start[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(end[p] >= 0, end[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(tcost[p] >= 0, tcost[p] <= max_t)

    active = (p < k)
    opt.add(Implies(active, f[p] < N))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(active), And(f[p] == N, start[p] == 0, end[p] == 0, tcost[p] == 0)))

    for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
        opt.add(Implies(f[p] == i, And(start[p] >= a, start[p] + d <= b, end[p] == start[p] + d)))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < k, q < k), f[p] != f[q]))

for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(Implies(f[0] == i, tcost[0] == travel[start_loc][loc]))

for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(f[p - 1] == i, f[p] == j), tcost[p] == travel[friends[i][1]][friends[j][1]]))

opt.add(Implies(k > 0, start[0] >= tcost[0] + start_min))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < k, start[p] >= end[p - 1] + tcost[p]))

total_end = end[0]
for p in range(1, N):
    total_end = total_end + end[p]

opt.maximize(k)
opt.minimize(total_end)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    k_val = m.eval(k, model_completion=True).as_long()
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    cur = start_min
    cur_loc = start_loc

    for p in range(k_val):
        i = m.eval(f[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        name, loc, a, b, d = friends[i]

        t = travel[cur_loc][loc]
        if t > 0:
            arrive = cur + t
            ans.append(f"You travel to {locs[loc]} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
            cur = arrive
            cur_loc = loc
        else:
            cur_loc = loc

        ms = m.eval(start[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        me = m.eval(end[p], model_completion=True).as_long()

        if ms > cur:
            ans.append(f"You wait until {fmt(ms)}.")
            cur = ms

        ans.append(f"You meet {name} for {me - ms} minutes from {fmt(ms)} to {fmt(me)}.")
        cur = me

    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')
else:
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')

# Problem 1
from z3 import *

def fmt(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    mm = m % 60
    if h == 0:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = 12
    elif h < 12:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = h
    elif h == 12:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = 12
    else:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = h - 12
    return f"{hh}:{mm:02d}{ap}"

def quote(s):
    if "'" in s:
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return "'" + s + "'"

locs = ["The Castro", "Mission District", "Financial District"]
travel = [
    [0, 7, 20],
    [7, 0, 17],
    [23, 17, 0]
]
start_loc = 0
start_min = 540
friends = [
    ("Laura", 1, 735, 1185, 75),
    ("Anthony", 2, 750, 885, 30)
]

N = len(friends)
opt = Optimize()
k = Int("k")
opt.add(k >= 0, k <= N)
f = [Int(f"f_{p}") for p in range(N)]
start = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(N)]
end = [Int(f"end_{p}") for p in range(N)]
tcost = [Int(f"tcost_{p}") for p in range(N)]
max_t = max(max(row) for row in travel)

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(f[p] >= 0, f[p] <= N)
    opt.add(start[p] >= 0, start[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(end[p] >= 0, end[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(tcost[p] >= 0, tcost[p] <= max_t)
    active = (p < k)
    opt.add(Implies(active, f[p] < N))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(active), And(f[p] == N, start[p] == 0, end[p] == 0, tcost[p] == 0)))
    for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
        opt.add(Implies(f[p] == i, And(start[p] >= a, start[p] + d <= b, end[p] == start[p] + d)))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < k, q < k), f[p] != f[q]))

for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(Implies(f[0] == i, tcost[0] == travel[start_loc][loc]))
for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(f[p - 1] == i, f[p] == j), tcost[p] == travel[friends[i][1]][friends[j][1]]))

opt.add(Implies(k > 0, start[0] >= tcost[0] + start_min))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < k, start[p] >= end[p - 1] + tcost[p]))

total_end = end[0]
for p in range(1, N):
    total_end = total_end + end[p]
opt.maximize(k)
opt.minimize(total_end)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    k_val = m.eval(k, model_completion=True).as_long()
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    cur = start_min
    cur_loc = start_loc
    for p in range(k_val):
        i = m.eval(f[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        name, loc, a, b, d = friends[i]
        t = travel[cur_loc][loc]
        if t > 0:
            arrive = cur + t
            ans.append(f"You travel to {locs[loc]} in {t} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arrive)}.")
            cur = arrive
            cur_loc = loc
        else:
            cur_loc = loc
        ms = m.eval(start[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        me = m.eval(end[p], model_completion=True).as_long()
        if ms > cur:
            ans.append(f"You wait until {fmt(ms)}.")
            cur = ms
        ans.append(f"You meet {name} for {me - ms} minutes from {fmt(ms)} to {fmt(me)}.")
        cur = me
    print('[' + ', '.join(quote(s) for s in ans) + ']')
else:
    print('[]')

# Problem 5
from z3 import *

def fmt(m):
    h = (m // 60) % 24
    mm = m % 60
    if h == 0:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = 12
    elif h < 12:
        ap = "AM"
        hh = h
    elif h == 12:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = 12
    else:
        ap = "PM"
        hh = h - 12
    return f"{hh}:{mm:02d}{ap}"

def quote(s):
    if "'" in s:
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return "'" + s + "'"

locs = [
    "Union Square",
    "The Castro",
    "North Beach",
    "Embarcadero",
    "Alamo Square",
    "Nob Hill",
    "Presidio",
    "Fisherman's Wharf",
    "Mission District",
    "Haight-Ashbury"
]
travel = [
    [0, 17, 10, 11, 15, 9, 24, 15, 14, 18],
    [19, 0, 20, 22, 8, 16, 20, 24, 7, 6],
    [7, 23, 0, 6, 16, 7, 17, 5, 18, 18],
    [10, 25, 5, 0, 19, 10, 20, 6, 20, 21],
    [14, 8, 15, 16, 0, 11, 17, 19, 10, 5],
    [7, 17, 8, 9, 11, 0, 17, 10, 13, 13],
    [22, 21, 18, 20, 19, 18, 0, 19, 26, 15],
    [13, 27, 6, 8, 21, 11, 17, 0, 22, 22],
    [15, 7, 17, 19, 11, 12, 25, 22, 0, 12],
    [19, 6, 19, 20, 5, 15, 15, 23, 11, 0]
]
start_loc = 0
start_min = 540
friends = [
    ("Melissa", 1, 1215, 1275, 30),
    ("Kimberly", 2, 420, 630, 15),
    ("Joseph", 3, 930, 1170, 75),
    ("Barbara", 4, 1245, 1305, 15),
    ("Kenneth", 5, 735, 1035, 105),
    ("Joshua", 6, 990, 1095, 105),
    ("Brian", 7, 570, 930, 45),
    ("Steven", 8, 1170, 1260, 90),
    ("Betty", 9, 1140, 1170, 90)
]

N = len(friends)
opt = Optimize()
k = Int("k")
opt.add(k >= 0, k <= N)

f = [Int(f"f_{p}") for p in range(N)]
start = [Int(f"start_{p}") for p in range(N)]
end = [Int(f"end_{p}") for p in range(N)]
tcost = [Int(f"tcost_{p}") for p in range(N)]
max_t = max(max(row) for row in travel)

for p in range(N):
    opt.add(f[p] >= 0, f[p] <= N)
    opt.add(start[p] >= 0, start[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(end[p] >= 0, end[p] <= 1440)
    opt.add(tcost[p] >= 0, tcost[p] <= max_t)

    active = (p < k)
    opt.add(Implies(active, f[p] < N))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(active), And(f[p] == N, start[p] == 0, end[p] == 0, tcost[p] == 0)))

    for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
        opt.add(Implies(f[p] == i, And(start[p] >= a, start[p] + d <= b, end[p] == start[p] + d)))

for p in range(N):
    for q in range(p + 1, N):
        opt.add(Implies(And(p < k, q < k), f[p] != f[q]))

for i, (name, loc, a, b, d) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(Implies(f[0] == i, tcost[0] == travel[start_loc][loc]))

for p in range(1, N):
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            opt.add(Implies(And(f[p - 1] == i, f[p] == j), tcost[p] == travel[friends[i][1]][friends[j][1]]))

opt.add(Implies(k > 0, start[0] >= tcost[0] + start_min))
for p in range(1, N):
    opt.add(Implies(p < k, start[p] >= end[p - 1] + tcost[p]))

total_end = end[0]
for p in range(1, N):
    total_end = total_end + end[p]

opt.maximize(k)
opt.minimize(total_end)

if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    k_val = m.eval(k, model_completion=True).as_long()
    ans = [f"You start at {locs[start_loc]} at {fmt(start_min)}."]
    cur = start_min
    cur_loc = start_loc

# Problem X
from z3 import *

def fmt(t):
    h = t // 60
    m = t % 60
    suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
    h12 = h % 12
    if h12 == 0:
        h12 = 12
    return f"{h12}:{m:02d}{suffix}"

start_loc = "..."
start_time = 9 * 60
locs = [...]
travel = {...}
for a in locs:
    travel[(a, a)] = 0
friends = [...]

n = len(friends)
sel = [Bool(f"sel{i}") for i in range(n)]
pos = [Int(f"pos{i}") for i in range(n)]
st = [Int(f"st{i}") for i in range(n)]
en = [Int(f"en{i}") for i in range(n)]
makespan = Int("makespan")
count = sum(If(sel[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n))

opt = Optimize()
opt.add(makespan >= start_time, makespan <= 1440)

for i, (name, loc, a_start, a_end, min_dur) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(pos[i] >= 0, pos[i] <= n)
    opt.add(Implies(Not(sel[i]), pos[i] == n))
    opt.add(Implies(sel[i], pos[i] < count))
    opt.add(st[i] >= 0, en[i] >= 0, st[i] <= 1440, en[i] <= 1440, en[i] >= st[i])
    opt.add(Implies(sel[i], And(st[i] >= a_start, en[i] <= a_end, en[i] - st[i] >= min_dur)))
    opt.add(Implies(And(sel[i], pos[i] == 0), st[i] >= start_time + travel[(start_loc, loc)]))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(sel[i]), And(st[i] == 0, en[i] == 0)))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        opt.add(Implies(And(sel[i], sel[j]), pos[i] != pos[j]))

for k in range(n - 1):
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i == j:
                continue
            opt.add(Implies(And(sel[i], sel[j], pos[i] == k, pos[j] == k + 1),
                            st[j] >= en[i] + travel[(friends[i][1], friends[j][1])]))

for i in range(n):
    opt.add(Implies(sel[i], makespan >= en[i]))

total_dur = sum(en[i] - st[i] for i in range(n))
opt.maximize(count * 1000000000 - makespan * 100000 - total_dur)

res = opt.check()
if res == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    selected = [i for i in range(n) if m[sel[i]].is_true()]
    selected.sort(key=lambda i: m[pos[i]].as_long())
    statements = [f"You start at {start_loc} at {fmt(start_time)}."]
    cur_loc = start_loc
    cur_time = start_time
    for i in selected:
        name, loc, a_start, a_end, min_dur = friends[i]
        tt = travel[(cur_loc, loc)]
        if cur_loc != loc:
            arr = cur_time + tt
            statements.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {tt} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arr)}.")
            cur_time = arr
            cur_loc = loc
        ms = m[st[i]].as_long()
        if cur_time < ms:
            statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(ms)}.")
            cur_time = ms
        me = m[en[i]].as_long()
        statements.append(f"You meet {name} for {me - ms} minutes from {fmt(ms)} to {fmt(me)}.")
        cur_time = me
        cur_loc = loc
    print(statements)
else:
    print([f"You start at {start_loc} at {fmt(start_time)}."])

def fmt(t):

    ("Haight-Ashbury", "Mission District"): 11,
    ("Haight-Ashbury", "Bayview"): 18,
    ("Fisherman's Wharf", "Haight-Ashbury"): 22,
    ("Fisherman's Wharf", "Richmond District"): 18,
    ("Fisherman's Wharf", "Mission District"): 22,
    ("Fisherman's Wharf", "Bayview"): 26,
    ("Richmond District", "Haight-Ashbury"): 10,
    ("Richmond District", "Fisherman's Wharf"): 18,
    ("Richmond District", "Mission District"): 20,

    ("Mission District", "Haight-Ashbury"): 12,
    ("Mission District", "Fisherman's Wharf"): 22,
    ("Mission District", "Richmond District"): 20,
    ("Mission District", "Bayview"): 15,
    ("Bayview", "Haight-Ashbury"): 19,
    ("Bayview", "Fisherman's Wharf"): 25,
    ("Bayview", "Richmond District"): 25,
    ("Bayview", "Mission District"): 13,
}
for a in locs:
    travel[(a, a)] = 0

friends = [
    ("Sarah", "Fisherman's Wharf", 14 * 60 + 45, 17 * 60 + 30, 105),
    ("Mary", "Richmond District", 13 * 60, 19 * 60 + 15, 75),
    ("Helen", "Mission District", 21 * 60 + 45, 22 * 60 + 30, 30),
    ("Thomas", "Bayview", 15 * 60 + 15, 18 * 60 + 45, 120),
]

n = len(friends)
sel = [Bool(f"sel{i}") for i in range(n)]
pos = [Int(f"pos{i}") for i in range(n)]
st = [Int(f"st{i}") for i in range(n)]
en = [Int(f"en{i}") for i in range(n)]
makespan = Int("makespan")
count = sum(If(sel[i], 1, 0) for i in range(n))

opt = Optimize()
opt.add(makespan >= start_time, makespan <= 1440)

for i, (name, loc, a_start, a_end, min_dur) in enumerate(friends):
    opt.add(pos[i] >= 0, pos[i] <= n)
    opt.add(Implies(Not(sel[i]), pos[i] == n))
    opt.add(Implies(sel[i], pos[i] < count))
    opt.add(st[i] >= 0, en[i] >= 0, st[i] <= 1440, en[i] <= 1440, en[i] >= st[i])
    opt.add(Implies(sel[i], And(st[i] >= a_start, en[i] <= a_end, en[i] - st[i] >= min_dur)))
    opt.add(Implies(And(sel[i], pos[i] == 0), st[i] >= start_time + travel[(start_loc, loc)]))
    opt.add(Implies(Not(sel[i]), And(st[i] == 0, en[i] == 0)))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        opt.add(Implies(And(sel[i], sel[j]), pos[i] != pos[j]))

for k in range(n - 1):
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i == j:
                continue
            opt.add(Implies(And(sel[i], sel[j], pos[i] == k, pos[j] == k + 1),
                            st[j] >= en[i] + travel[(friends[i][1], friends[j][1])]))

for i in range(n):
    opt.add(Implies(sel[i], makespan >= en[i]))

total_dur = sum(en[i] - st[i] for i in range(n))
opt.maximize(count * 1000000000 - makespan * 100000 - total_dur)

res = opt.check()
if res == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    selected = [i for i in range(n) if m[sel[i]].is_true()]
    selected.sort(key=lambda i: m[pos[i]].as_long())
    statements = [f"You start at {start_loc} at {fmt(start_time)}."]
    cur_loc = start_loc
    cur_time = start_time
    for i in selected:
        name, loc, a_start, a_end, min_dur = friends[i]
        tt = travel[(cur_loc, loc)]
        if cur_loc != loc:
            arr = cur_time + tt
            statements.append(f"You travel to {loc} in {tt} minutes and arrive at {fmt(arr)}.")
            cur_time = arr
            cur_loc = loc
        ms = m[st[i]].as_long()
        if cur_time < ms:
            statements.append(f"You wait until {fmt(ms)}.")
            cur_time = ms
        me = m[en[i]].as_long()
        statements.append(f"You meet {name} for {me - ms} minutes from {fmt(ms)} to {fmt(me)}.")
        cur_time = me
        cur_loc = loc
    print(statements)
else:
    print([f"You start at {start_loc} at {fmt(start_time)}."])
